page.notes: Greek column at left and bottom is printed in Greek; transcription of Greek is approximate in places. Marginal letters A–F are reference marks between the columns. Headings: "CAPVT VI." is a level 1 heading with caput 6 (printed as a chapter heading), and the Greek "Κεφάλαιον 5." is a sub-heading. The final Greek lines at the foot are partly illegible. The right column's first line of the body after "CAPVT VI." is a drop-cap "A".
